question: When is production expected to begin in J M Smucker's (NYSE: SJ) new distribution center in McCalla, Alabama?
model_answer:
When J.M. Smucker announced the McCalla facility, it said production would begin in calendar year 2025. Construction was expected to begin no later than January 2022, with production commencing in calendar year 2025. The $1.1 billion site is a manufacturing facility and distribution center for Smucker's Uncrustables sandwiches.

That timeline has since been overtaken by events, because the plant opened early. A Food Business News article says the 900,000-square-foot plant opened in November 2024. An ABC 33/40 report notes that the original goal was 2025 but that production date was moved up.

The company is now working on the next stage. Smucker is accelerating plans to bring the second phase of the McCalla facility online toward the end of fiscal 2027.
judge_reason: Model states the 2025 production expectation; its mention of the November 2024 opening is a later revision that does not deny that expectation.
